svg.title: Battery Revenue Optimizer data platform layers
svg.desc: Public spot and reserve prices are ingested by a Lambda into an S3 raw zone, loaded into Postgres and modelled by dbt into daily strategy marts, served by a Flask API and dbt docs.
svg.text: Battery Revenue Optimizer: data platform layers
From public market prices to a verdict per zone and day: spot arbitrage or frequency reserves, and how much a perfect optimiser could add
parsed, UTC keys, DST and quirks
Ingest at 13:30 (spot) and 10:00 (SvK), then load_raw and dbt build; freshness alert at 14:00
Staging and intermediate are dbt views; marts are tables rebuilt by every dbt build
